evidence: Feng–Mordant arXiv:2609.26597 abstract confirms the d=2,3 limiting laws are explicit weighted sums of independent centered exponentials.
correctness.rationale: Starting from the centered-exponential spectral series, the cumulant generating function of Y_d=-L_d is K_d(s)=sum_{[k]}(s a_k-log(1+s a_k)), a_k=1/(2 pi^2 |k|^2). In d=3, the lattice Riemann sum gives K_3(s)~A s^(3/2), A=1/(3 sqrt(2) pi); the radial integral follows by differentiating J(a), and the Legendre constant 4/(27 A^2)=8 pi^2/3 was independently recomputed. In d=2, Abel summation with N(r)=pi r^2+O(r) gives K_2'(s)~(4 pi)^(-1) log s and K_2''(s)=O(s^-1). Chernoff upper bounds and exponential tilting, with variance negligible at the saddle scale, give matching lower bounds. The monotone inversion to lower quantiles is valid. No finite-sample tail claim is inferred from weak convergence.

final_claim: For the explicit two- and three-dimensional flat-torus matching limit laws L_2,L_3, the extreme lower tails satisfy log log(1/P(L_2<=-x))/x -> 4 pi and -log P(L_3<=-x)/x^3 -> 8 pi^2/3, with the stated lower-quantile asymptotics.
limitations: Limiting laws only; no finite-sample extreme-tail approximation.
